keeper-hd-rouleren-hoge-hoek.naam: High ball into the corner: rotating with two keepers
keeper-hd-rouleren-hoge-hoek.uitleg: Keeper 2 kicks the ball from hands high into the corner; keeper 1 dives high and catches it. Roll the ball back, then swap: keeper 1 goes to the serving spot, keeper 2 goes in goal and gets a high ball into the other corner.
keeper-hd-rouleren-hoge-hoek.organisatie: Goal, serving spot at 11 m (disc cone). Swap after every 2 balls. Two keepers per goal, or three (the third collects balls).
coachpunten: A small step towards the ball first, then take off and stretch
Catch the ball at the highest point, in front of your body
Server: high into the corner, but saveable (not into the top corner)

moeilijker: Distance 16 m, kicked hard
Alternate catching and tipping
Straight after landing, a second ball low into the other corner

keeper-cv-kruispas-vangen-zwaaiworp.naam: Crossover steps, catch and sidearm throw
keeper-cv-kruispas-vangen-zwaaiworp.uitleg: The keeper moves from post to post with crossover steps, shuffles back to the middle and catches a chest-height ball from the coach. Straight after, they send the ball flat and long with a sidearm throw to a zone on the wing.
keeper-cv-kruispas-vangen-zwaaiworp.organisatie: Disc cones by both posts, coach at 9 m, 8 × 8 m zone on the wing at 20 m. Each set, throw to the other wing.
coachpunten: Crossover step: back leg crosses in front, shoulders stay facing the pitch
Catch first, then turn towards the direction of the throw
Sidearm throw: arm straight out to the side, keep the ball flat

makkelijker: Roll instead of a sidearm throw
moeilijker: The ball comes during the crossover steps
Throw to a moving teammate
After the throw, back again for a low ball

keeper-re-via-de-pop.uitleg: A mannequin stands in front of goal. The coach shoots past or at the mannequin: if the ball goes past, it comes as expected; if it hits the mannequin, it suddenly changes direction. The keeper stays in the ready position until they see the new direction and then reacts.
keeper-re-via-de-pop.organisatie: Keeper in goal, mannequin 5 m in front of goal, coach at 12 m. The coach chooses: past the mannequin or at it.
coachpunten: Don't guess: stay in the ready position until the ball has passed the mannequin
Weight on the balls of your feet so you can go either way
Short, explosive push-off in the new direction

makkelijker: Mannequin further from the keeper (more reaction time)
moeilijker: Two mannequins
Mannequin closer to the keeper (3 m)
Shoot harder
After the save, a second shot past the other side of the mannequin

keeper-sp-lummelen.naam: Piggy in the middle for keepers
keeper-sp-lummelen.uitleg: Two keepers throw the ball to each other; the keeper in the middle tries to intercept it by jumping or diving. Whoever loses the ball goes in the middle. A game of throwing, catching, jumping and reacting.
keeper-sp-lummelen.organisatie: 10 × 6 m area. Throwers on the short sides, the middle keeper between them. Throws only (underarm or overarm), no kicking. Ball intercepted = swap.
coachpunten: Throwers: fake a throw and release the ball quickly and accurately
Middle keeper: take off from one foot and take the ball at the highest point
Catch with two hands, even in the air

makkelijker: The middle keeper may only jump, not run
moeilijker: Two middle keepers
Throwers may not move
Rolling balls only: the middle keeper has to dive

keeper-sp-mikken-in-de-hoepel.uitleg: Two young keepers take turns to throw their ball into a hoop: underarm with a little arc when it's close, overarm when it's further away. In the hoop is a point; who has the most after 10 throws? A fun way to practise distribution.
keeper-sp-mikken-in-de-hoepel.organisatie: Four hoops 4 to 8 m from the throwing line. Two keepers, each with a ball. After the throw, fetch your own ball and go back to the line.
coachpunten: Underarm: step in with the other leg and release the ball low
Overarm: arm straight behind your head, then whip it through
Look at the hoop, not at the ball

moeilijker: Hoops further away (10–15 m)
Rolled through a gate
A hoop that the coach moves around

keeper-wu-tweetallen-drie-hoogtes.uitleg: Two keepers face each other and throw the ball to each other at different heights: a rolling ball (scoop), a ball at stomach height (basket), a chest-height ball and a high ball above the head (W grip). Whoever catches it throws it straight back.
keeper-wu-tweetallen-drie-hoogtes.organisatie: Two keepers 8 m apart, one ball per pair. After 10 balls, increase the distance to 10–12 m. Several pairs side by side, 5 m apart.
coachpunten: Hands behind the ball: for a high ball thumbs together (W), for a low ball little fingers together
Chest-height ball: elbows together and trap the ball against your chest
Rolling ball: step towards it, knee behind the ball, scoop it in
Watch the ball into your hands

makkelijker: The same height until it goes well
moeilijker: The thrower chooses the height without saying
After every catch, a 3 m sprint backwards and back
With two balls at once: one high, one rolling

keeper-wu-balgewenning.naam: Getting a feel for the ball: throw up, bounce and scoop
keeper-wu-balgewenning.uitleg: The keeper works alone with a ball: throw it high and catch it at the highest point in the air, let it bounce in front of them and catch it after the bounce, and roll it away, sprint after it and pick it up.
keeper-wu-balgewenning.organisatie: Each keeper has their own ball and a 5 × 5 m space. Each task 5 times, then the next. Good as a first block while the coach sets up the rest.
coachpunten: High ball: take off from one foot, other knee up, catch at the highest point
After the bounce: body behind the ball, not just your hands
Rolling ball: scoop it with both hands, don't grab at it with one hand

makkelijker: Catch the ball against your chest after the bounce
moeilijker: Clap your hands once before catching
Throw the ball up behind you, turn and catch
Two keepers with a ball each: throw to each other at the same time
After the set, a low ball from the coach: get up from the scoop and dive

keeper-wu-zit-tikken-vangen.naam: Seated: touch the ground and catch
keeper-wu-zit-tikken-vangen.uitleg: The keeper sits on the ground with legs straight. Before each ball, they touch the ground behind them with both hands and come back quickly; the coach throws and the keeper catches at chest height and throws it back.
keeper-wu-zit-tikken-vangen.organisatie: The keeper sits on the grass, the coach (or another keeper) stands 3–4 m away with a ball. After 6–8 balls, swap or move on to the next variation.
coachpunten: After touching the ground, hands straight back in front of the body (W shape)
Catch with your fingers, pull the ball into your chest
Straight back, core switched on

moeilijker: Ball just beside the body
The coach throws while the keeper is still touching the ground

keeper-wu-zit-drie-hoogtes.uitleg: The keeper sits with legs straight. The coach alternates throws at chest height, above the head and low beside the body. Catch, secure and throw it back.
keeper-wu-zit-drie-hoogtes.organisatie: The keeper sits on the grass, the coach (or another keeper) stands 3–4 m away with a ball. After 6–8 balls, swap or move on to the next variation.
coachpunten: Chest height: basket or chest catch
Above the head: W shape with thumbs behind the ball, arms straight
Low: hands to the ball, little fingers together

makkelijker: The coach calls the height beforehand
moeilijker: Harder and quicker in succession
After every ball, roll backwards and come back up

keeper-wu-zit-knieen-opgetrokken.uitleg: The keeper sits with knees bent and feet flat on the ground. The coach throws low, at chest height and high; the keeper catches and throws it back. This trains catching with a strong core.
keeper-wu-zit-knieen-opgetrokken.organisatie: The keeper sits on the grass, the coach (or another keeper) stands 3–4 m away with a ball. After 6–8 balls, swap or move on to the next variation.
coachpunten: Feet flat, knees stay up
For the high ball, don't fall backwards: core switched on
Catch in front of your body, not beside it

makkelijker: Hands on the ground behind you between balls
moeilijker: Feet off the ground (balancing on your seat)
Balls to the left and right of the body

keeper-bv-grondballen.uitleg: The coach plays the ball along the ground at the keeper. The keeper moves towards the ball with small steps and scoops it up. The second ball comes slightly to one side: shuffle across first, then scoop. Roll the ball back each time.
keeper-bv-grondballen.organisatie: Keeper in goal, coach at 10 m with a few balls. Balls straight at the keeper and 1–2 m to the side, alternating left and right.
coachpunten: Step towards the ball, don't wait for it
Legs together or one knee behind the ball: it mustn't go through you
Little fingers together, scoop the ball into your chest

moeilijker: Shoot harder
Ball 2–3 m to the side of the keeper
The ball bobbles just in front of the keeper (like a bumpy pitch)
After the catch, throw straight out to a disc cone on the wing

keeper-laag-duiken-kniezit.uitleg: The keeper kneels between two disc cones. The coach throws the ball low beside the keeper. The keeper falls sideways onto their side, catches the ball, gets up, kneels again and rolls the ball back. Alternate left and right.
keeper-laag-duiken-kniezit.organisatie: In the goal or between two poles. Two disc cones 3 m to the left and right of the keeper, in line with where they kneel. The coach stands at 6 m with the balls beside them.
coachpunten: Dive diagonally forwards, towards the ball (not backwards)
Bottom hand behind the ball, top hand on top; pin the ball to the ground
Land on your side: hip, thigh and shoulder, not on your elbow
Eyes on the ball until it's secure

makkelijker: Roll the ball instead of throwing
Shorter distance and closer to the body
Start from sitting with legs apart
moeilijker: Dive from a crouch or standing
Ball harder or further from the body
Straight after getting up, a second ball on the other side
The coach chooses the side: the keeper has to react

keeper-ld-hurkzit.uitleg: The next step after kneeling: the keeper crouches with knees deeply bent. The coach plays the ball along the ground beside them. The keeper pushes off from the leg on the ball side, dives diagonally forwards and secures the ball. Get up, back into a crouch, roll the ball back.
keeper-ld-hurkzit.organisatie: Keeper crouching in goal, coach at 8 m. Balls along the ground 1.5–2 m from the keeper, alternating left and right.
coachpunten: Push off from the leg on the ball side, diagonally forwards
Hands to the ball first: bottom hand behind, top hand on top
Land on your side and pin the ball to the ground straight away

moeilijker: Ball further away (2.5 m)
Shoot harder
The coach shoots without saying which side
After the dive, get up and a high ball on the other side straight away

keeper-ld-stand-twee-keepers.naam: Low diving from standing: two keepers
keeper-ld-stand-twee-keepers.uitleg: Keeper 1 stands in the ready position in goal. Keeper 2 throws a low ball into one corner and then kicks a ground ball into the other corner. Keeper 1 dives, secures the ball and rolls it back. Then the keepers swap places and roles.
keeper-ld-stand-twee-keepers.organisatie: Goal, server at 8 m. Swap after 2–4 balls: the keeper coming out of goal takes the ball to the serving spot.
coachpunten: From the ready position, a small step towards the ball first, then push off
Don't bend your knees first and then fall: one movement diagonally forwards
Up quickly after the dive and back into the ready position

moeilijker: The server chooses the corner
Two balls in quick succession (left, then right)
Distance 11 m, kicked hard

keeper-cv-drie-schoten-positie.naam: Three shots: take up a new position each time
keeper-cv-drie-schoten-positie.uitleg: The coach shoots from three spots in a row: angled from the left, central and angled from the right. After each save, the keeper quickly takes up a new position on the line between the ball and the centre of the goal before the next shot comes.
keeper-cv-drie-schoten-positie.organisatie: Three balls at 12–17 m: left, centre and right. The coach moves from ball to ball. The keeper punches or catches and resets straight away.
coachpunten: After every save: position first, then the ready position
From an angle: near post shut
Small quick steps, never cross your feet when the ball is about to come

makkelijker: The coach waits until the keeper is set
moeilijker: The coach chooses the order
Four or five spots
After the last shot, one more back pass to play away

keeper-vz-positie-meeschuiven.uitleg: The coach dribbles down the wing from deep towards the byline. The keeper moves with them: while the ball is far away they stand more central and slightly off their line; at the byline they cover the near post. At the end, a low, driven cross comes in which they intercept in front of the near post.
keeper-vz-positie-meeschuiven.organisatie: Keeper in goal, coach with a ball on the wing 20 m from the byline. The coach dribbles steadily to the byline and then delivers a low cross towards the near post. Then from the other side.
coachpunten: Ball far away: one or two metres off your line and more central
Ball at the byline: near post shut, but don't hug the post
Low cross: step towards the ball and take it before the striker

makkelijker: The coach stands still at three spots instead of dribbling
moeilijker: The coach chooses: low cross, high cross or shot
A player (or second keeper) attacks the near post
Harder, more driven cross
